Bucharest Metropolitan Area, Romania

 About Autolink
 Autolink is a fast-growing automotive technology company focused on next-generation intelligent cockpit, IVI (In-Vehicle Infotainment), and central computing platforms. We work with leading OEM customers to deliver scalable, high-performance vehicle software and hardware solutions for global markets.
 As part of our European expansion, we are establishing our Romania R&D Center in Bucharest to support customer programs, local engineering delivery, and future product innovation.
 About the Role
 We are looking for a Senior Automotive Software Integration Engineer to join our Romania R&D Center.
 In this role, you will be responsible for software integration, system builds, release management, and continuous delivery for next-generation IVI and cockpit platforms. You will work closely with engineering teams in Romania and China to ensure high-quality software releases for internal validation, customer milestones, and production programs.
 This is a great opportunity to join a growing engineering center from an early stage and play a key role in building our European software capability.
 Responsibilities
Own daily software integration activities for IVI / cockpit platforms
Manage software builds, release baselines, and version deliveries
Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Git, Gerrit, or similar tools
Support Linux / Android system image generation, packaging, and deployment
Coordinate with BSP, middleware, application, and testing teams to ensure successful integration
Troubleshoot build failures, dependency conflicts, and system-level issues
Deliver stable and testable software releases for internal teams and customer milestones
Improve release efficiency, automation coverage, and software quality processes
Support issue analysis during validation and customer testing phases
Contribute to engineering best practices for the Romania R&D Center
 Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field
5+ years of experience in software integration, build/release engineering, or embedded software development
Strong knowledge of Linux environments and Shell / Python scripting
Hands-on experience with Git, branching strategies, Gerrit, Jenkins, CI/CD workflows
Experience in troubleshooting complex software integration issues
Good understanding of embedded systems or automotive software development lifecycle
Strong communication skills in English
Self-driven, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in an international environment
Solid understanding of Multi-version management within a single baseline,and skilled in judging when and how to create a software branch in order to reduce unnecessary maintenance efforts
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience with automotive IVI, cockpit domain controller, telematics, or ECU software projects
Experience with Android Automotive OS, AOSP, Yocto, or Embedded Linux BSP
Familiarity with Qualcomm, NXP, Renesas, or similar automotive platforms
Knowledge of CAN/LIN/Ethernet vehicle communication systems
Experience working with OEM / Tier 1 automotive customers
Knowledge of ASPICE, ISO 26262, or automotive quality processes
 Why Join Us
Be part of the founding team of our Romania R&D Center
Work on next-generation intelligent cockpit and vehicle software platforms
Exposure to international automotive customer programs
Career growth opportunities in a fast-scaling global business
Collaborative and multicultural working environment
 Equal Opportunity Statement
 Autolink is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or background.
